title: Visualified
body:
# Visualified

A Fabric modpack for Minecraft 26.1.2 focused on making the game look, sound and feel better. No new dimensions, no progression overhauls, just vanilla done right.

161 mods total. Good performance, nice visuals, quality of life stuff that should've been in the game ages ago.

## ✨ What's Inside

### 🚀 Performance
**Sodium**, **Lithium**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **FerriteCore**, **ModernFix**, **EntityCulling**, **MoreCulling**, **C2ME**, **Krypton**, **Noisium** and a few more. FPS goes up, loading times go down.

### 🎨 Visuals & Shaders
- **Iris** (shader support, works with most shaderpacks)
- **Continuity** (connected textures)
- **LambdaBetterGrass** (better grass edges)
- **Entity Model Features** + **Entity Texture Features** (CEM/CTM support for resource packs)
- **SkinLayers3D** (3D player skin layers)
- **WaveyCapes** (cape physics)
- **3D Armor** (armor visible in 3D on the player model)
- **Elytra Trims** + **Tool Trims** (trim support for elytra and tools)
- **Dimension Based Shaders** (different shaderpack per dimension)

### 🌿 World Atmosphere
- **Falling Leaves** (leaves fall off trees)
- **Snow Real Magic** + **Snow Under Trees** (snow builds up properly)
- **Windy** (wind particles)
- **Visuality** + **Particular** + **Particle Effects** + **Particle Tweaks** (more particles everywhere)
- **Ripple** (water ripples when you walk)
- **Cool Rain** (rain looks better)
- **Dive In** (underwater feels more alive)

### 🔊 Sound
- **Sound Physics Remastered** (reverb in caves, echo in big rooms, etc.)
- **Ambient Sounds** (environment has actual background noise)
- **Presence Footsteps** (footsteps depend on what you're walking on)

### 🖥️ HUD & UI
- **Enhanced Tooltips** (tooltips show durability, enchants, food values)
- **AppleSkin** (shows saturation and hunger exhaustion)
- **Health Bars** (HP bars above mobs)
- **Simple Armor HUD** (armor durability on screen)
- **DualBar** (dual locator bar for xp and Players)
- **Enchantment Descriptions** + **Enchantment Insights** + **Effect Insights** (actually explains what things do)
- **Advanced Loot Info** (loot table preview)
- **Tool Stats** (weapon and tool stats)
- **Better Tab** (nicer player list)
- **Ping Wheel** (ping markers in multiplayer)
- **Death Locator** (marks where you died)
- **Xaero's World Map** (map with waypoints)

### ⚙️ Quality of Life
- **JEI** (recipe and item browser)
- **Mouse Tweaks** (better inventory clicking)
- **Easy Anvils** + **Easy Magic** (less painful anvil and enchanting costs)
- **Tax Free Levels** (XP costs are less annoying)
- **Visual Workbench** (items stay visible in the crafting table)
- **Fast Trading** (no more waiting on villager animations)
- **Simple Trash Slot** (trash slot in inventory)
- **Mod Menu** (manage and configure mods in-game)
- **Resourcify** (install resource packs without leaving the game)
- **Freelook** + **Zoomify** (look around and zoom)
- **Flashback** (replay recording built in)
- **WorldEdit** (for those who build stuff)

### 🎮 Extra
- **Controlify** (controller support)
- **No Telemetry** (Mojang data collection turned off)
- **Debugify** (fixes a bunch of vanilla bugs)
- **Bedrockify** (some Bedrock features ported over)
- **Minecraft Capes** (OptiFine/LabyMod/Minecraftcapes capes work)

## 📋 Requirements

| | |
|:--|:--|
| **Minecraft** | 26.1.2 |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric |
| **RAM** | 4-6 GB recommended |

## 📝 Notes

- No shaderpack included, install one through the Iris menu (Complementary, BSL, Rethinking Voxels all work great)
- Most mods work on servers, a few are client-side only
- You can browse and install resource packs directly in-game with Resourcify
